newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks jump 1.03 pct at open.
newsitem.headline: French stocks jump 1.03 pct at open.

text.p: French shares opened with a 1.03 percent jump for the blue-chip index on the back of solid gains on Wall Street and supported by the dollar, dealers said.
The market was also boosted by the February future breaking important resistance at 2,570 and 2,594.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 25.07 points or 0.98 percent at 2,592.16 at 0904 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was up at 2,595 from 2,570 on Monday's close.
Sanofi was up 0.54 percent to 558 francs after reporting an 11 percent rise in 1996 net earnings, slightly below analysts' expectations.
Eramet gained 5.56 percent, after an 11 percent loss on Monday when the French government announced it was starting a procedure to withdraw the company's mining licence for Koniambo in New Caledonia.
AGF adds another 6.01 percent in big volume on continued rumours it could be taken over.
